partners.mechanism_chain: EXOSC9 (HGNC:27800) —DISRUPTS→ RNA processing and turnover (GO:0006396); RNA processing and turnover (GO:0006396) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormalities of the cerebellum (HP:0001272); EXOSC9 (HGNC:27800) —DISRUPTS→ B cell differentiation (GO:0030097); B cell differentiation (GO:0030097) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormalities of B cell differentiation (HP:0011784). Loss-of-function mutations in EXOSC9 disrupt general RNA processing and turnover, which in turn affects cerebellar development leading to pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 1D.
